transformation: Year-over-year percentage change (derived from raw index levels)
variable_definition: Monthly CPI growth = (CPI index this month / CPI index same month one year earlier - 1) * 100. Coverage counts months with both actual finite inputs and a positive year-earlier index; no filling, monthly aggregation or scaling. Original index coverage: 801 valid months, 1959-01–2025-09. Annual Index column excluded. The September 2025 and September 2024 levels (109.82 and 108.46) match DGBAS headline CPI, base 2021=100. This verifies the series match for that example, not every historical value or vintage. Seasonal adjustment is not documented in the CSV. Rates are calculated from supplied rounded levels, not directly reported YoY figures; later revisions/rebasing may change historical inputs. Common availability uses five countries and measures period coverage, not definition equivalence.
